ip_top_stories.title: Meta and Anthropic win key verdicts in US AI copyright cases
ip_top_stories.summary: Meta and Anthropic have secured significant legal victories in US AI copyright cases. The outcomes mark important precedents in ongoing disputes over whether training large language models on copyrighted material constitutes infringement.

ip_top_stories.title: Google Will Appeal a German Ruling That Makes It Legally Liable When Its AI Overviews Lie
ip_top_stories.summary: A German court has ruled that Google is legally liable for false information generated by its AI Overviews feature, treating the output as Google's own statements. Google has announced it will appeal the landmark decision, which could have significant implications for AI-generated content liability across Europe.

ip_top_stories.title: The Google Music AI Reckoning Begins As Independent Artists Launch Massive Class Action Lawsuit Over Copyright Infringement And Unauthorized Training Of Lyria Models On YouTube Content
ip_top_stories.summary: Independent artists have filed a class action lawsuit against Google, alleging copyright infringement through the unauthorised use of YouTube content to train its Lyria AI music models. Google is defending its position by pointing to YouTube's terms of service, which it argues permit such use for AI training purposes.

ip_top_stories.title: Japan to Draw Up Rules to Protect Intellectual Property in AI Age
ip_top_stories.summary: Japan has announced plans to establish new rules to protect intellectual property rights in the context of AI development and deployment. The move signals growing governmental attention to IP frameworks that can keep pace with rapid advances in AI technology.

ip_top_stories.title: Dutch Court Artist Receives Damages Over Far-Right AI Image Alteration
ip_top_stories.summary: A Dutch court has awarded damages to an artist whose image was altered using AI by a far-right group without consent. The ruling addresses questions around AI-assisted manipulation of copyrighted works and moral rights.

ip_further_links.title: Meta will face US claims of pirating pornographic content for AI
ip_further_links.summary: A US court has ruled that Meta must face claims that it used pirated pornographic content to train its AI systems.

ip_further_links.title: Google Defends AI Training Rights Through YouTube Terms in Music Copyright Lawsuit
ip_further_links.summary: Google is arguing that YouTube's terms of service grant it the right to use uploaded content for AI training in its defence against the music copyright class action.

ip_further_links.title: How a small Canadian publisher is resisting the AI book wave
ip_further_links.summary: A small Canadian publisher describes its strategy for resisting AI-generated content and protecting human authorship in its publishing programme.

ip_further_links.title: AI Regulation and the Looming Problem of the Takings Clause
ip_further_links.summary: Analysis of how the US Constitution's Takings Clause could complicate AI regulation, particularly in cases where government rules restrict how AI companies use copyrighted or proprietary data.

ip_further_links.title: Wolters Kluwer expands its Libra AI workspace with authoritative Swiss legal content from leading publisher Stampfli
ip_further_links.summary: Wolters Kluwer has announced an expansion of its Libra AI legal workspace by licensing authoritative Swiss legal content from publisher Stampfli, illustrating continued growth in AI-driven legal content licensing.
